Elisa Gomez: Heads-up: next Wednesday's all-hands at 10:30 AM PT (https://meet.redwood.ai/allhands-wed). Agenda + slides: https://notion.redwood.ai/p/allhands-2026-transparency. Please drop Qs in the doc by Tues EOD. :wave:

Jon Park: Exec update will include a short policy change overview and a frank recap of the recent control-plane incident. We'll cover what happened, mitigations, and customer-facing next steps.

Mina Rao: Adding a 90s security segment on KMS roadmap and audit logging. Will include opt-in instructions for stricter retention for Dedicated/Private.

SecurityBot: Incident RCA link posted: https://status.redwood.ai/2026/control-plane-rca. Action items tracked in the runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/control-plane-followup.

Elisa Gomez: Recording will be uploaded to the company drive and annotated with timestamps for the policy and incident sections. If you can't attend, add priority Qs to the doc so we can call them out live.

Jon Park: Can comms prepare a one-paragraph customer note for immediate post-meeting distribution? I can review copy Monday.

Mina Rao: Will join the prep dry-run Monday 9:15 AM PT. Also testing live captions please flag accessibility issues in the doc.

allhands-bot: Reminder scheduled: all-hands in 3 days at 10:30 AM PT. Recording + transcript will auto-upload within 60 minutes after the meeting. :bell:

Elisa Gomez: Thanks everyone 1 if you want a 2-min speaking slot, DM me by Tuesday noon. See you Wednesday. :sparkles:
